text:
sophie: quick follow-up from postmortem #502 / can we lock down owners and short deadlines for rollout safety items? keeping this concise.
jamal: +1, split by priority pls (hot / short / backlog).
anya: hot: emergency flag + fast opt-out path. i can do the flag toggles (env var + console expando) and a runtime fallback to safe-model pool. target: 2026-03-31.
mike: hot: auto-rollback controller rules + unit/canary tests. sketching conditions: error_rate >= 1.5% for 3m OR p95 latency > 1.8s for 2m. will push PR w/ tests by 2026-04-01.
rachel: short: UI for flag scoping and traffic caps (default 5% canary). i'll own the modal + API. ETA: 2026-04-07.
sophie: backlog: policy editor + rollout templates + audit logs. can live on roadmap after hot items.
anya: note: add a KV-warmup gate for models with >4GB KV. require cache-prefix-hit >= 70% before ramp. this would have avoided the cold-start surge.
mike: adding to controller: require KV gate + model-compat check (quantization/ops) before increasing traffic. also add a manual "force-skip-gate" that requires SRE signoff.
jamal: can we add rollout telemetry grouped by model-family, quant_variant, and region? we need to see regressions caused by model swaps.
sophie: yes. i'll add those fields to the canary event schema. also add alerting rules: grouped anomaly on model+variant with 5m dedupe.
rachel: for console UX: add tooltip and example presets (5% x15m, 25% x30m). link to runbook in the modal.
anya: runbook note: how to flip flag rapidly and how to perform manual rollback from console. small copy + screenshots needed. sophie want to own the doc?
sophie: i will. will update postmortem and put runbook link in the modal.
oncall-bot: Reminder created: "Rollout safety check-ins" weekly Monday 10:00 starting 2026-03-30. Attendees: eng-platform, eng-runtime, eng-sre.
mike: tests: i'll add a canary harness that can simulate traffic spikes and KV cold starts so auto-rollback and KV gates are validated in CI. target infra PR by 2026-03-30.
anya: ownership summary: emergency opt-out flag -> anya (2026-03-31); auto-rollback + tests -> mike (2026-04-01); console caps + presets -> rachel (2026-04-07); telemetry + alerts -> sophie (2026-03-30); runbook + docs -> sophie (2026-03-30).
jamal: i'll wire the feature-flag API changes with platform config and expose audit events for legal/compliance teams. ETA: 2026-04-05.
sophie: please add blockers in the sheet. i'm creating a tracking spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/rollout-safety-followups (owner: sophie).
rachel: small UX note: make "emergency opt-out" visible to oncall by default and hide advanced options behind permission.
mike: adding automated rollback reasons to incident timeline so postmortem tooling picks them up automatically.
anya: also proposing a small monthly trend report for recurring incidents (kv cold starts, model-swap regressions). that'll help prioritize roadmap hardening.
sophie: closing checklist: 1) emergency flag + fallback -> anya -> 2026-03-31; 2) auto-rollback controller + harness -> mike -> 2026-04-01; 3) console caps & presets -> rachel -> 2026-04-07; 4) telemetry/alerts changes -> sophie -> 2026-03-30; 5) runbook & modal links -> sophie -> 2026-03-30; 6) weekly follow-ups scheduled by oncall-bot. reply if missing. :white_check_mark:
jamal: looks good. pls ping me when the API shape is ready so I can do the compliance audit.
sophie: thanks everyone, i'll update the postmortem doc and close this thread once PR links are in. :wave:
